name: telco_churn
notes: Messy, binary. IBM extended version. Churn Value and Churn Reason are left in and are excluded automatically by the leakage check. Churn Score (IBM's own model prediction, single-column ROC-AUC 0.942) was warned about but not excluded, so it is dropped here: another model's output is not a customer attribute.

name: german_credit
notes: Credit risk, binary. Space-separated file without a header; column names from german.doc. Costs from the dataset's documented cost matrix: classing a bad customer as good costs 5, classing a good customer as bad costs 1.

name: bank_marketing
notes: Marketing, imbalanced binary. 'duration' (call length) is dropped: it is only known after the call, and the UCI documentation says to discard it for a realistic model.

name: bike_demand
notes: Demand, regression. 'casual' + 'registered' = 'cnt' by definition, so both are dropped (a leak spread across two columns).
